steps.code:
# Store downloaded song IDs
downloaded_ids = {song['song_id'] for song in downloaded}

# Loop: check current song, if not downloaded, go to next
while True:
    current = apis.spotify.show_current_song(access_token=access_token)
    print("Current song:", current['song_id'], current['title'])
    if current['song_id'] in downloaded_ids:
        print("Found downloaded song:", current['title'])
        break
    # Go to next song
    next_resp = apis.spotify.next_song(access_token=access_token)
    print("Next song response:", next_resp)
